reconstruction_candidate.method: Interpolate each source series in thousands then convert to persons and round once per series. Sum the rounded parts.
reconstruction_candidate.uncertainty_kind: Sum of the source-series sensitivity limits. No coverage interval calibrated for the combined opening geography.
reconstruction_candidate.scope: The two source series are mutually exclusive at country-series level. Recombine under one political root. Panama and the later Canal Zone must not be standalone opening populations. The CELADE table has no frontier or island breakdown. Territorial exactness is unverified for the western Panama frontier and offshore islands, and the Putumayo/Leticia frontier. No map cell allocations follow from these totals.

boundary_note: The handbook reproduces the 1899 British Guiana award and the 1891 Colombia award. Its area comparison still takes 1,552,741 km² from the 1896 Venezuelan yearbook. The area figures cannot be used to adjust population.

existing_observations.uncertainty_kind: Interpolated sensitivity limits from the FT series.

opening_comparison.decision: Retain the legacy value as the opening control. The publication date and original geographic scope of that value are undocumented. The three source series are alternative national totals and overlap. The handbook series omits immigration in 1899–1904 and has no verified match to the opening perimeter. CELADE reports a year-only estimate with no frontier or resident-category detail. FT follows a different reconstruction with a lower starting level. No overlap counts allow a territorial subtraction, and none of the sources supplies a verified 1900-01-01 control.
